summary: Booming tech civ that ages up through House of Wisdom wings. The usual pro plan is Economic Wing into a second Town Center, a fast Castle for relics, then a third Town Center.
openings: Economic Wing into 2 TC: Feudal at about 2:15, Fertile Crescent around 4:00, then Fresh Foodstuffs and a second Town Center, usually on the wood line.
Military Wing into a stable and 2 TC: a flexible opening against long-Feudal civs like Delhi, with the second Town Center on deer around 6:15.

spikes.label: Second Town Center
spikes.detail: With the Economic Wing the second Town Center lands around 5 to 6 minutes. If it survives to farms at about 22 minutes, Abbasid is usually winning even after losing villagers.
spikes.answer: Pressure the second Town Center and deny its resources while the start is still slow.

spikes.label: Fast Castle relics
spikes.detail: After 2 TC they rush Castle for relics and a third Town Center.
spikes.answer: Contest relics and keep raiding so they can't sit back and boom.

scout: Second Town Center going up around 5 to 6 minutes means the Economic Wing boom
A stable early means the Military Wing opening
Their House of Wisdom placed forward can be reached with rams, which also blocks their age-up

pairings.why: Wood-heavy and easy to run off two Town Centers.
When food is plentiful, and against French knight-archer play.

winConditions.detail: Two-Town-Center economy into Castle relics and a third Town Center.
Raids rather than sitting in base.

howToBeat: Pressure the second Town Center and deny its resources.
Ram the House of Wisdom if it's placed forward.
French tools (knights and extra scouts stealing deer) are good against the slow start.
